div.head: II As 20.6
div.ab: Gif he nylle geþafian, lætan hine licgan, butan he oþwinde.
Gif he nylle hit geþafian, leton hine licgan, buton he oþwinde.
Gif he nelle …, letan hine licgan, buton he oðwinde.
Gif he nylle hit geþafian, leton hine licgan, buton he oþwinde.
And if he is not willing to consent thereto, they shall put him to death, unless he escapes.
If he will not permit it, he is to be killed, unless he escapes.
Wenn er das sich nicht gefallen lassen will, lassen sie ihn, wenn er nicht entflieht, [straflos] getödtet werden.
If he will not submit to that, let them have him lie dead [without penalty], unless he escapes.
